referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A two-field opening. A saturated mint panel carries an oversized black title, a small all-caps descriptor, a credit line, and a downward arrow; a full-height photograph fills the opposite half. Below, stacked chapters use short headings and text columns, followed by an elements demonstration and a contact block. The typography is a bold geometric sans with tight display leading. Mint, black, and white dominate, with photography supplying the only texture.
